extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic performance extracted from Figures 1 and 7. Figure 1a caption reports pressure and WHSV but no reaction temperature; no temperature was assigned for those entries. Figure 4d/e show log-transformed kinetic reaction-order plots (ln rate vs ln partial pressure), and Figure 4f is an Arrhenius plot; these were not digitised as plant-performance data because the plotted values are transformed kinetic quantities and Arrhenius plots are explicitly skipped. Figures 2, 3, 5, and 6 are characterization/mechanistic DRIFTS/XPS/STEM/TPR plots and were skipped. In Figure 7c, CO hydrogenation bars were skipped because they are not CO2 hydrogenation.
